Groomsman duties don't typically involve inappropriate interactions; it's a structured event. The " walking with a female cousin" part is standard in weddings— often, groomsman and bridesmaids walk together as part of the ceremony. It's not a romantic or intimate role; it's a formal, familial one.

Also, ultimatums in a new relationship are red flags. They're often used to control or manipulate. A three-month relationship is still early; it's not reasonable to expect a partner to sacrifice family obligations for the relationship at this stage. 

The user's choice to prioritize the groomsman role is reasonable. He's not doing anything wrong by being part of his cousin's wedding.
